name: browser.step-verify
description: After a commit verb ran: did the page do what the step said it would? Claim-verify lane (jev-tape lane 2) over one post-action snapshot plus a code-computed label diff. Replaces a 20–150 s `vibium check` model loop with one ~130 ms POST for literal claims; non-literal claims escalate to Check. Canonical copy: JEV-works kit/modules/contexts/browser.step-verify.json. Status: drafted; login-verify derived from handoffs/vibium/interview-login-verify.md; neither measured yet.

artifact.type: post-action browser snapshot with a claim

modules.name: step-verify
modules.purpose: Generic: does the after-snapshot support the step's stated expectation?

outcome.instructions: Which of these does the page evidence say about the claim?

criteria.verified: The page text, title, address, content type, or newly present elements state what the claim says.
criteria.contradicted: The page states the opposite of the claim, or shows the state the claim says has ended.
criteria.unsupported: The evidence neither confirms nor denies the claim.

outcome.note: A selected option is a verdict only when the distribution is peaked. Measured 2026-09-28: Wikipedia Special:Search after Enter gave verified 0.48 / unsupported 0.28 / contradicted 0.24 (normalised entropy ~0.94) and the old rule accepted it; real verified answers on eight pages sat at 0.93–0.97 (entropy < 0.3). Rule 0 escalates above 0.6 (L23: measure the range before trusting an entropy gate; this one is measured on both sides).

errorShown.instructions: Does the page show an error or failure message about what was just attempted?

criteria.true: The text states that something is invalid, failed, was rejected, is not allowed, or must be tried again.
criteria.false: No error or failure is stated.

blocked.instructions: Which stop, if any, is the page showing instead of the expected result?

criteria.one_time_code: It asks for a code sent by text message, email, or an authenticator app.
criteria.captcha: It asks the person to prove they are human.
criteria.cookie_banner: A cookie or consent banner covers part of the page.
criteria.login_wall: It asks the person to sign in before continuing.
criteria.error_page: A 403, 404, 500, or a browser error page is showing.

compose.positive: the step's expectation holds on the page

notForJev.judgement: Did the address change, and to what?
notForJev.instead: String compare in code; sent as urlChanged and afterUrl so the judge reads it instead of computing it.
labelDiff() in code over the two maps, ignoring ref numbers (vibium diff map is positional and re-numbers on any insert).
vibium wait load / wait url / wait text in code, before the snapshot.

notForJev.judgement: Is the claim about something not on the page (a cookie, an email, a database row)?
notForJev.instead: vibium eval / cookies in code, or vibium check; this pack reads the page only.
Session state and the operator's retry policy in code; a second submit is never the judge's call.

modules.name: login-verify
modules.purpose: Specialised: did a sign-in land, so that the next step may run without an LLM turn or a person? Leaves come from the operator interview (Q1 success signs, Q2 failure signs).

signedInSignsShown.instructions: Does the page show a sign that a person is signed in, such as a greeting by name, a secure-area message, an account or profile menu, or a sign-out control?

criteria.true: The text or the new elements include a greeting by name, a signed-in or secure-area message, an account menu, or a logout / sign-out control.

loginFormGone.instructions: Have the password field and the sign-in button gone from the page?

criteria.true: The removed elements include a password field or a sign-in button, and the text no longer asks for a password.
criteria.false: A password field or a sign-in button is still present.

credentialErrorShown.instructions: Does the page show an error about the credentials, such as wrong password, unknown account, locked account, or try again?

criteria.true: The text states that the password, username, or account was rejected or locked.

interstitial.instructions: Which stop is the page showing that is neither the signed-in page nor a credential error?

criteria.one_time_code: It asks for a code sent by text message, email, or an authenticator app.
criteria.captcha: It asks the person to prove they are human.
criteria.cookie_banner: A cookie or consent banner covers part of the page.
criteria.password_expired: It asks the person to set a new password before continuing.
criteria.none: None of these stops is showing.

compose.positive: the sign-in landed and the next step may run

notForJev.judgement: Did the address change to the expected landed page? (interview Q1.3, Q3.1)
notForJev.instead: Exact or regex match on afterUrl in code, before any model call.
vibium cookies in code, compared to the expected name.

notForJev.judgement: How long has the page been settling? (Q5)
notForJev.instead: A timer in code with the operator's budget; on timeout, escalate, never ask the model whether it is slow.

notForJev.judgement: Is the next step a purchase, a send, or a delete? (Q4)
notForJev.instead: Policy.humanGate in code: those steps park for a human verdict even on GREEN.

notForJev.judgement: Has this sign-in been retried already? (Q5.3)
notForJev.instead: Session state in code; a second submit is never decided by the model.
